subject.cultural_details: [Appropriate jewellery, jasmine flowers, kolam, traditional instruments, lamps, or other relevant details]
subject.expression_and_mood: Natural, joyful, respectful, expressive, and emotionally believable

setting.location: [Tamil Nadu village, traditional Tamil home, temple courtyard, Chettinad mansion, coastal town, agricultural field, or another specific location]
setting.environment: [Authentic architecture, local vegetation, traditional decorations, and appropriate surroundings]
setting.cultural_context: [Specify the festival, occasion, regional tradition, or everyday activity]
setting.authenticity: Represent Tamil Nadu's regional culture accurately. Use historically and culturally appropriate objects, clothing, architecture, and customs. Avoid mixing unrelated regional traditions.

lighting.quality: Soft, realistic, cinematic light with natural shadows and believable highlights
lighting.mood: [Warm, celebratory, peaceful, devotional, energetic, or nostalgic]

camera.shot_type: [Wide establishing shot, medium shot, close-up portrait, or detailed macro shot]
camera.angle: [Eye-level, slightly low angle, overhead, or another suitable perspective]
camera.lens: [35mm for environmental storytelling, 50mm for natural perspective, or 85mm for portraits]
camera.depth_of_field: [Deep focus for architecture and cultural scenes, or shallow depth of field for portraits]
camera.composition: [Balanced composition, clear subject separation, natural proportions, and intentional foreground and background]
camera.quality: High detail, realistic anatomy, sharp focal subject, natural skin texture, physically plausible perspective

palette.color_grading: Rich but believable colors, realistic skin tones, controlled highlights, and no excessive saturation

style.visual_style: [Photorealistic cinematic photography, documentary photography, traditional painting, or illustrated travel poster]
style.detail_level: Highly detailed cultural craftsmanship, realistic fabrics, accurate architectural features, and convincing materials
style.overall_feeling: Beautiful, dignified, culturally grounded, authentic, and visually memorable

text_in_image.instruction: If text is enabled, use only the exact requested wording. Ensure Tamil script is correctly formed and legible. Otherwise, include no lettering.

things_to_avoid: Incorrect or generic South Indian cultural representation
North Indian festival clothing or customs inserted without contextual justification
Inaccurate temple architecture or invented historical details
Incorrect traditional garments, jewellery, hairstyles, or draping
Plastic-looking skin, excessive beauty filters, or artificial expressions
Anatomical errors, malformed hands, extra fingers, duplicated people, or distorted faces
Floating objects, physically impossible shadows, or inconsistent reflections
Excessive saturation, artificial HDR, or unrealistic lighting
Unrequested text, misspelled Tamil words, watermarks, logos, or random lettering
Crowded composition that obscures the main subject
Mixing unrelated cultural symbols merely for decoration
final_instruction: Generate one cohesive, visually compelling image. Prioritize cultural accuracy, regional specificity, believable human details, authentic materials, and strong visual storytelling over decorative excess.
